title: Recovery from bounded-above truncations
statement:
For every $E\in D(T_{\Et},\Lambda)$, the canonical morphism

$$
\operatorname{hocolim}_{N\to+\infty}\tau_{\le N}E\longrightarrow E
$$

is an isomorphism, where the homotopy colimit is that of
[def-kun-truncations].

proof.text: Choose a cochain complex $C^\bullet$ of $\Lambda_T$-module sheaves representing $E$, using [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Realize the good truncations of [def-kun-truncations] by the subcomplexes $C_N=\tau_{\le N}C$: $C_N^i=C^i$ for $i<N$, $C_N^N=\ker(d^N)$, and $C_N^i=0$ for $i>N$. This is the standard truncation subcomplex in [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category], shifted from degree zero to degree $N$. Its differential into degree $N$ is $d^{N-1}$ with codomain restricted to $\ker(d^N)$, since $d^Nd^{N-1}=0$. The inclusions $C_N\to C_{N+1}\to C$ define the truncation sequence and its compatible cocone to $C$. We index it by $N\in\mathbf N$, which is sufficient for $N\to+\infty$.

source.place: Tag 0118, section-truncations, canonical truncation of cochain complexes

proof.text: For every integer $i$, choose $M\in\mathbf N$ with $M>i+1$. In degrees $i$ and $i+1$, all $C_N$ for $N\ge M$ equal $C$, the transition maps are identities and the differential is $d^i$. The cocone $C_N^i\to C^i$ is colimiting: a compatible family of maps $C_N^i\to F$ is uniquely determined by its map $C_M^i=C^i\to F$, because for $N<M$ compatibility forces the composite $C_N^i\to C_M^i\to F$, and for $N\ge M$ forces the same map. Thus the induced map $\varinjlim_N C_N^i\to C^i$ is an isomorphism. Write $j_N^i:C_N^i\to L^i$ for the structure maps into the degreewise colimit and $a^i:L^i\to C^i$ for the resulting isomorphism. The colimit differential $\delta^i$ is determined by $\delta^i j_N^i=j_N^{i+1}d_{C_N}^i$. Since each inclusion $b_N:C_N\to C$ is a chain map, $(a^{i+1}\delta^i)j_N^i=b_N^{i+1}d_{C_N}^i=d^ib_N^i=(d^ia^i)j_N^i$. Uniqueness in the colimit universal property gives $a^{i+1}\delta^i=d^ia^i$. Thus the degreewise isomorphisms $a^i$ form an isomorphism of complexes $\varinjlim_N C_N^\bullet\xrightarrow{\sim}C^\bullet$.

source.place: Proof, termwise colimit of the truncations; explicit eventually constant calculation

proof.text: Apply [lem-kun-complex-colimit-hocolim] to this sequence of complexes of etale module sheaves: its canonical morphism $\operatorname{hocolim}_N C_N\to\varinjlim_N C_N$ is a quasi-isomorphism. Compose it with the complex isomorphism to $C$ constructed in step 2. This composite is the canonical morphism in the statement: the map to the termwise colimit followed by its cocone map to $C$ is induced by the inclusions $C_N\to C$. In the localization at quasi-isomorphisms of [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the first map is invertible and the second already is invertible. Their composite is therefore an isomorphism to $E$.
